n, m, x = map(int, input().split())
st = []
for _ in range(n):
    p, c = map(int, input().split())
    st.append((p, c))
st.sort()
a = [0] * m
b = [0] * m
for i in range(m):
    a[i], b[i] = map(int, input().split())
neg = []
pos = []
res = 0
for i in range(m):
    if a[i] >= b[i]:
        pos.append((a[i] - b[i], i))
    else:
        neg.append((a[i] - b[i], i))
    res += b[i] * x
neg.sort()
pos.sort(reverse=True)
l, r = 0, n - 1
for i in neg:
    while r >= 0 and st[r][1] == 0:
        r -= 1
    res += (a[i[1]] - b[i[1]]) * st[r][0]
    st[r] = (st[r][0], st[r][1] - 1)
for i in pos:
    while l < n and st[l][1] == 0:
        l += 1
    res += (a[i[1]] - b[i[1]]) * st[l][0]
    st[l] = (st[l][0], st[l][1] - 1)
print(res * 2)
